notes: タワー・本拠地のクリスタル・ミニオンの生成 3D モデルの仕様。concept は Codex（ChatGPT ログインの画像生成）で作り、model は Tripo（P1）か Meshy（smart-topology meshy-t2）で作る。画像・GLB は build/structures/<id>/（git 管理外）。チーム色は青チームの配色で作り、赤チームは bake の色相の付け替え（青〜紫 → 赤〜マゼンタ）で別テクスチャにする（メッシュは 1 つ）。
style: Single 3D game asset concept render for a stylized fantasy x sci-fi mobile MOBA (Mobile Legends: Bang Bang / Honor of Kings art direction): hand-painted stylized PBR textures, chunky readable silhouette, clean bevelled shapes, polished gold/brass metal combined with deep navy-blue enamel armor plates, and glowing cyan-blue crystal energy as the accent color (the team color). Show exactly ONE object, whole and uncropped, centered, three-quarter view from slightly above (about 30 degrees), isolated on a plain flat light-grey (#d8d8d8) background, evenly lit, no ground plane, no cast shadow on the background, no other objects, no particles, no text, no frame. Original design (do not copy any existing game asset).

assets.use: タワー（外塔・内塔・基地塔で共用）の本体。頂部の結晶球は tower_orb（浮遊・回転・破壊で落下）
assets.prompt: a lane defense guard tower: a wide round stepped base platform made of gold/brass and navy-blue metal with four short curved brass pipe feet around its rim and small glowing cyan light gems set into the rim; from its center rises a tall tapering dark navy-blue clockwork column wrapped with gold gear rings and spiral grooves, a large golden cog wheel mounted on one side of the column and a slim vertical brass lever arm on the other side; at the very top an open four-pronged golden claw cradle pointing upward that is EMPTY (nothing inside or above it: no orb, no crystal, no ball). Total height about 1.5 times the base diameter.

assets.use: タワー頂部の浮遊する結晶球（チーム色。回転・上下・破壊で落下）
assets.prompt: a floating spherical crystal orb power core: a faceted glowing cyan-blue gemstone sphere (low-poly faceted surface, bright glowing inner light) held inside two thin crossing golden ring bands, with a small ornate golden cap on the top and the bottom of the sphere. Nothing else.

assets.use: 本拠地（Core）の台座。中央の結晶は core_crystal
assets.prompt: the base platform of a MOBA team's home crystal nexus: a large wide circular stepped pedestal of pale cream stone with gold trim and deep navy-blue enamel panels, six short golden mechanical pylons evenly spaced around the outer rim, each pylon topped with a small glowing cyan crystal, glowing cyan rune lines inlaid in the steps, and a raised round central socket in the middle that is EMPTY (nothing on it: no crystal, no orb). Wide and low: the height is about one quarter of the diameter.

assets.use: 本拠地（Core）の浮遊する大結晶（チーム色。回転・上下・破壊で落下）
assets.prompt: a giant floating energy crystal for a MOBA base nexus: one big tall double-pointed faceted gem crystal (elongated octahedron shape), glowing bright cyan-blue from inside with lighter cyan-white facet edges, several smaller crystal shards clustered around its waist, and an ornate golden band with navy-blue inlays around its middle. Nothing else, no base, no stand.

assets.use: 近接ミニオン（剣と盾の兵士）
assets.prompt: a small sturdy armored soldier minion with chibi proportions (big head about one third of the height): a stocky little knight in gold-trimmed navy-blue plate armor, a round helmet with a glowing cyan visor slit, a round navy-blue shield with a gold rim on the left arm, a short broad sword held down at the right side, standing in a neutral pose, full body including feet.

assets.use: 遠隔ミニオン（杖を持つ魔術師）
assets.prompt: a small robed mage minion with chibi proportions: a hooded navy-blue robe with gold trim and a pointed hood, the face hidden in shadow with two glowing cyan eyes, holding a slim golden staff topped with a glowing cyan crystal upright in the right hand, the robe flares out at the bottom like a bell (no visible legs), full body.

assets.use: 攻城ミニオン（大砲の車）
assets.prompt: a small siege cannon war machine minion: a compact four-wheeled cart built of dark wood and brass with navy-blue armored side plates and gold trim, one big brass cannon barrel on top pointing forward, a glowing cyan crystal power core mounted on the back, four chunky round wheels. Seen from the front-left three-quarter view so the cannon points toward the lower left.
